name: Drone charge
notes: Part 5c (design/05 §3.4). Drone part: placed in the Drone tab. The drone dives into its target and is destroyed. Art: drone shaped charge: a P2 warhead casing with two P3 bands, a brass fuze block and proximity probe on the nose, a red arming lamp, P1 stabilising fins and a release shackle on top.
